en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a general view of a small village nestled in a valley with hills around it. At the center stands a large Romanesque church with a tall bell tower surrounded by clustered stone houses and farm buildings. The printed caption at the top identifies the scene as being near Clermont-Ferrand and specifically Orcival. The overall design and typography are typical of early 20th‑century French postcards.
